item.text:
Both approved posts are live in one ad group with a $350 total cap and an initial daily budget of $29.17. The flight runs from midnight on 19 August through the end of 30 August, UK time, targeting adults across the UK and Ireland on iOS and Android. The available platform controls don’t distinguish phones from tablets.

I’ll check delivery and costs during the flight. Link clicks will guide adjustments, but they won’t establish which post produces more trial starts.

The first two days delivered 51,101 impressions and 30 link clicks for $54.47. The second post has a slightly lower cost per click, but there’s too little evidence to favor it yet. I’m keeping both running; spend is close to plan.

After five days, spend is $140.13 for 75 link clicks and 129,681 impressions. Both posts now cost about $1.87 per click, so I’m retaining both. I’ve raised the daily budget to $30 to catch up slightly, with the $350 total cap still in place.

Entering the final day, the campaign has spent $312.97 for 297,230 impressions and 170 link clicks. Recent cost per click improved to $1.65. I’ve made the remaining $37.03 available for today; the flight still ends at midnight UK time.
